name: Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom and rule of law in the Czech Republic: threats to the independence of public broadcasters
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking the Czech government and parliament to act. It asks them to keep Czech public television and radio funded in a stable, independent way, to fix the prime minister's conflict of interest over EU funds, and to stop political pressure on journalists and civil society. It also asks the European Commission to watch the Czech legislation closely.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks Czech authorities to change their funding and ethics rules.
- **Who it affects:** Czech Television, Czech Radio, Czech journalists, civil servants and civil society groups.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to monitor Czech laws and report back to Parliament.
